teaser: What does it take to finish something the slow way, when the fast way would also do? That is the question life path 4 puts in front of you, met here as an INFJ, someone already noticing what needs mending before anyone asks. The 4 wants the structure built right; the INFJ wants it to mean something besides working. The two do not compete so much as take turns checking each other's work. A plan gets drawn, then redrawn, because it has to hold weight and also hold true. The result is rarely fast. It is, more often, exactly what it claims to be.
excerpt: Zipping the tent flap against the cold, you check it twice though the first check was fine — that is as much a declaration as anything said aloud.
